variants.headline: Builder signs for a new project
variants.body: The builder {builder} has signed a contract for {project}. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.

variants.headline: A price agreed, a building still to deliver

variants.headline: Construction contract puts obligations in writing
